entities.name: Ottoman Hungary & Habsburg Reconquest
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: 150 years of Ottoman rule over central Hungary: Turkish baths in Buda, population decline, and continuous frontier warfare. The Great Turkish War (1683–99), the Siege of Buda (1686), and the Treaty of Karlowitz (1699) restored Habsburg control.
